author: Jose Luis Matzkin
text:
The Stabilo Point 88 Colorkilla is a specialized fineliner pen designed as an “ink eraser” within the Stabilo Point 88 product line. The Stabilo Point 88 is a popular fineliner known for its 0.4 mm metal-encased tip, hexagonal orange-and-white striped design, and wide range of vibrant colors. The Colorkilla variant is a white pen specifically intended to erase or correct ink from certain Stabilo Point 88 pens marked as “erasable.”
Key Features:
•Purpose: The Colorkilla is used to erase ink from Stabilo Point 88 erasable pens, which are identifiable by translucent caps and fine red stripes on the barrel. These erasable pens typically come in colors like black, blue, green, and red.
•How It Works: The Colorkilla applies a white ink-like substance that neutralizes or lifts the erasable ink, effectively removing it from the paper without leaving residue (on compatible inks). It doesn’t function like traditional correction fluid (e.g., liquid paper) that covers mistakes; instead, it chemically interacts with the erasable ink.
•Compatibility: It works best with Stabilo’s erasable Point 88 pens and may also erase royal blue fountain pen ink (such as from Stabilo’s Move Easy or Elastic Writer). It is not designed to erase regular Stabilo Point 88 pens or other non-erasable markers.
•Line Width: Like other Point 88 pens, it has a 0.4 mm tip, making it precise for corrections.
•Design: It shares the iconic hexagonal shape of the Point 88 series, with a ventilated cap that can be attached to the end of the pen.
Usage Notes:
•After erasing with the Colorkilla, you cannot immediately rewrite over the corrected area with an erasable Point 88 pen, as the ink won’t adhere properly. Instead, you’d need to use a regular (non-erasable) pen or marker to write over it.
•It’s marketed for students, professionals, or anyone who occasionally makes mistakes and wants a clean way to correct them, especially in note-taking, sketching, or schoolwork.
Availability:
The Colorkilla is often sold as part of sets (e.g., alongside erasable Point 88 pens) or as a single pen. For example, a common set might include four erasable colors (black, blue, green, red) and one or two Colorkilla pens.
In summary, the Stabilo Point 88 Colorkilla is a niche tool in the Point 88 family, offering a unique erasable ink correction system for specific compatible pens, blending precision with practicality.
